title: Restriction coherence of the explicit target sheaf comparison
statement: Let Λ be a commutative ring, p:X→S and g:T→S arbitrary scheme morphisms, q an integer, and F an étale Λ-module sheaf on T. For U over T, construct the canonical comparison C_U from the base-change target sheaf for U×_S X to the higher image of the fixed sheaf G=pr_T^*F on U×_T(T×_S X). Specifically C_U is baseChangeTargetFunctorIso followed by higherDirectImageTransition along the explicit pullback-associativity isomorphism, followed by the higher-image map of the upperStarComp coefficient isomorphism. For any φ:U→V over T, the baseChangeTargetTransition for φ followed by its coefficient identification and C_U equals C_V followed by higherDirectImageOverMap for Over.pullback(pr_T)(φ). The transitions are those of [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions] and [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions], and the coefficient inverse images are [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. This is a sheaf morphism equality; it contains neither a stalk functor nor an existential assertion.

proof.text: The explicit pullback comparison maps commute with a morphism over T: compose with the projections to U and X, use Over.w and pullback.lift_fst/lift_snd, then apply pullback.hom_ext. The coefficient comparison is the stated upperStarComp composite.

Expand the two restriction transitions before homology. Move coefficient maps past lowerStarPlusTransition using naturality of the derived unit and counit. Apply composition of the lower-star transitions to both routes through the pullback comparison; the geometric commutation identifies the resulting composite transition maps. The pullback-comparison composition identity, including its final inverse sheaf comparison, identifies their coefficient suffixes. Exact pullback-single comparisons and their naturality identify the baseChangeTargetFunctorIso prefixes. Cancel inverse composition comparisons, then apply integer-degree homology. Negative degrees require no additional hypothesis.
